P0 — AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION START

Authentication is now VERIFIED.

Do not stop.

Do not return another status report.

Start executing the engineering backlog immediately.

Rules:

1. Repair one verified issue at a time.
2. Create one branch per repair.
3. Add regression tests.
4. Run CI.
5. Merge only after CI PASS.
6. Deploy to Render.
7. Verify:
   - GitHub SHA
   - CI-tested SHA
   - Render SHA
   - /health SHA
   - /version SHA
8. Record evidence.

Continue automatically 24/7.

Do not wait for additional owner instructions between repairs.

After every completed repair return only:

- Issue repaired
- Root cause
- Files changed
- Commit SHA
- PR URL
- CI Run ID
- Render Deployment ID
- Production SHA
- PASS/FAIL

Continue until the stabilization backlog is complete or an explicit owner approval is required.
